comments.content: @wolfmic I think using `logger.error` instead of warn is fine for now.
Marketplace needs both otherwise the runs won't work, you will get the `installation is disabled` error.

Currently the logs are handled manually with `console` messages. They should use our logger package to follow our usual display standards and logic.
https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquibot-logger
C.f. https://github.com/ubiquibot/command-wallet/pull/2#discussion_r1668052899 and https://github.com/ubiquibot/command-wallet/pull/2#discussion_r1668051345
If you use the logger you should not have to manually build these string, use the returned value of the logger instead.

```suggestion
    await addCommentToIssue(context, logger.info("Skipping to register a wallet address because both address/ens doesn't exist").logMessage.diff);
```
you can directly inline it to male it simpler.
I think it would make more sense to just use `passthrough` from `mwjs` and actually use our real RPC package if possible.
Yes this happens. I guess it's fine for tests, but ideally our RPC shouldn't fail.
@0x4007 What do you think would be the best approach? In the context of testing, hardcoding an RPC that we are sure works seems ok, but having our RPCs would be preferable but more unstable.
@ariesgun I am okay with the changes, however the `Jest` testing suite is failing, please fix it first.

QA: https://github.com/Meniole/command-wallet/issues/5#issuecomment-2436531033
Please provide your own QA as well next time.
